verdict.rationale: Baseten documents deploying fine-tuned or custom models on dedicated GPUs, and Truss packages model code, weights, and dependencies into a deployable server via `truss push` or `baseten model push`. Training checkpoints can also be deployed as production endpoints with one CLI command, so serving your own weights is clearly supported. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of LoRA adapter upload or multi-LoRA serving, detail on how weights are uploaded or sourced (e.g., private storage vs Hugging Face), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
